progress.command:
ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pit-raw-XXXXXX); mkdir -p $ROOT/home $ROOT/agent $ROOT/work
S=$ROOT/tmux.sock; NODE=$(dirname "$(command -v node)"); P=$PWD
CMD="env -i PATH=$NODE:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$ROOT/home PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=$ROOT/agent TERM=xterm-256color LANG=C.UTF-8 PI_OFFLINE=1 PI_TELEMETRY=0 node $P/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/bundle/cli.js -ne -e $P/src/index.ts -e $P/test/support/raw-call-provider.js --no-skills --no-context-files --no-prompt-templates --offline --provider raw-fixture --model fixture --session-dir $ROOT/sessions; exec sleep 86400"
cd $ROOT/work
tmux -S $S -f /dev/null new-session -d -s raw -x 110 -y 60 "$CMD"
cap() { echo "== $1"; tmux -S $S capture-pane -p -t raw | grep -E '›|✓|✗' ; }
sleep 6
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw "run options fixture" Enter; sleep 4; cap after-turn
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw C-o; sleep 1.5; cap expanded
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw C-o; sleep 1.5; cap collapsed
tmux -S $S send-keys -t raw "run fixture" Enter; sleep 4; cap second-turn
echo "== session"; grep -o '"type":"toolCall"[^}]*}[^}]*}' $ROOT/sessions/*.jsonl | head -5
tmux -S $S kill-server; rm -rf $ROOT
